english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for picking or selecting something.
This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for choosing or picking one or more options.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for picking particular people or things out of a larger group.
This is the all-purpose choice when selecting one option from several.
Use 揀 when take means choose or pick rather than physically take something.
